status_reviews.researcher_notes: verdict: change -> construction (from proposed). GEM's own ProposalYear/ProposalMonth for this row (2022/10, currently on the sheet unreferenced) already post-dates the 2021-01 completion of the adjacent upstream Hukou-Jinshawan section -- consistent with Shenguili-Pengze being proposed as the follow-on downstream section once the upstream section was in trial operation. The Jiujiang municipal 14th-FYP energy plan (2023-06-09, independent of GEM and of the operator) then places 湖口-彭泽支线 -- hand-confirmed as the same overall branch project, referenced in shorthand dropping the mid-point 金砂湾/Jinshawan name -- as '开工建设' (construction commenced) and still needing to be '继续完成...建设' (construction completed) within the 14th FYP (2021-2025) as of that document's date. That is squarely 'construction', not 'proposed': a row whose construction has commenced and is an active, named task in a current government plan is no longer merely proposed. GEM's 'Phase I' (一期工程) label for this row is independently corroborated by BOTH sources above (the Jiujiang plan places it inside '江西省天然气管网一期工程'; the jxgajc.com notice's own title begins '江西省天然气管网一期工程...') -- this is NOT taken from the archive.org GEM screenshot's own 一期工程 label per RELAUNCH_NOTES item 9 (that label carries no evidentiary weight; it was independently re-derived from these two sources' own wording).
